candidates.name: Practice guide 50: requisition and cancellation procedures
verified_facts: HMLR guidance identifies plan defects that can trigger requisitions, including scale/orientation problems and missing plan markings.
The guide directs plan preparation to the Practice Guide 40 requirements.
semantic_limits: A plan with unresolved registration requisition defects is not promoted as high-confidence parcel geometry evidence.

candidates.name: OS Net positioning data
verified_facts: OS Net is Ordnance Survey's GNSS base-station network across Great Britain.
OS describes OS Net as supporting centimetre-level precision positioning for surveying and mapping.
Recorded OS Net RINEX data is available for post-processed GNSS workflows.
semantic_limits: Centimetre-level GNSS positioning capability does not reduce Environment Agency LiDAR raster RMSE or prove the accuracy of a parcel elevation sample by itself.
